description: This file defines the interface and functions for integrating the hiredis Redis client with the libev event loop, including event handling, attachment, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: redisLibevReadEvent
methods.description: Handles read events triggered by libev, calling redisAsyncHandleRead.

methods.name: redisLibevWriteEvent
methods.description: Handles write events triggered by libev, calling redisAsyncHandleWrite.

methods.name: redisLibevAddRead
methods.description: Enables read events on the libev loop for the given context.

methods.name: redisLibevDelRead
methods.description: Disables read events on the libev loop for the given context.

methods.name: redisLibevAddWrite
methods.description: Enables write events on the libev loop for the given context.

methods.name: redisLibevDelWrite
methods.description: Disables write events on the libev loop for the given context.

methods.name: redisLibevCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees the event structure.

methods.name: redisLibevAttach
methods.description: Attaches the redisAsyncContext to the libev event loop, initializing event watchers.
